# Untested in Godot.
# The Gradient interpolates linearly between its points (interpolation_mode is left at its default).
# fill_from and fill_to are the CSS gradient line of 270deg in a box with aspect ratio 1:1 (width:height).
var gradient := Gradient.new()
gradient.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 1.0])
gradient.colors = PackedColorArray([Color8(32, 32, 32), Color8(224, 224, 224)])

var texture := GradientTexture2D.new()
texture.gradient = gradient
texture.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_LINEAR
texture.fill_from = Vector2(1.0, 0.5)
texture.fill_to = Vector2(0.0, 0.5)
texture.width = 256
texture.height = 256
